name: ADK Deep Search Agent
description: Full-stack research agent on Google's ADK that plans, searches the web iteratively and writes a cited report after the user approves the plan.
whatItDoes: Given a research question, the agent drafts a multi-step plan, asks the user to approve it, then repeatedly searches and critiques its findings until it can produce a comprehensive report. It is a starting point for teams building their own research assistants on Gemini.
howItWorks: A FastAPI backend built with the Agent Development Kit hosts several cooperating agents (planner, researcher, critic, writer) that call search through Gemini function calling; a React frontend drives it. It runs locally with an AI Studio key or Vertex AI and can be deployed to Cloud Run or Agent Runtime.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_API_KEY
requirements.description: AI Studio key written to app/.env; Vertex AI variables are the alternative

requirements.name: make
requirements.description: Recipe is driven by Makefile targets
